full_judgment:
4. The writ-petitioner was appointed as a Lecturer of Khanshama College, Dinajpur on  01.02.1993 and thereafter on 12.01.2004 he was appointed as the Vice Principal of Esamoti Degree College, Chirirbondar, Dinajpur. On 04.03.2007 the Principal of the said College retired and by resolution dated 28.02.2007 the Governing Body assigned the writ-petitioner with the responsibility of Principal-in-Charge with effect from 05.03.2007. On 07.07.2008 a regular Governing Body was constituted, which received approval of the Inspector of Colleges and was valid for a period of three years up to 06.07.2011. By a D.O. letter dated 05.07.2009 the local Member of Parliament wrote to the Inspector of Colleges for reconstitution of the Governing Body of the said College replacing the President and Bidytushahi member and accordingly a new President and Bidyutshahi member were inducted by memo dated 17.08.2009 in accordance with Rule 6 of the জাতীয় বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় (অধিভুক্ত কলেজ/শিক্ষা প্রতিষ্ঠান সমূহের গভর্নিং বডি) সংশোধন সংবিধি ১৯৯৮. It was also stated in the said memo that the newly inducted representatives would remain in the said position until 06.07.2011. The writ-petitioner challenged the said Memo dated 17.08.2009 by filing the instant writ petition praying for an order of stay of the said memo and also for a direction upon the respondents restraining them from causing any undue obstacle to the petitioner to continue his duty and responsibility as the Principal-in Charge of the College in accordance with the circular contained in memo No. ০৭(ঢ-৭১৭)জাতীঃবিঃ/কঃপঃ/৩৪/৬৭৫(৫) dated 16.03.2008. By the impugned judgment and order the High Court Division made the Rule absolute directing the authorities to wipe the same out of the slate and to undo all orders that were based on the said Rule 6, inclusive; of the order by Which the Chairman and the Edu-Enthusiast Member were displaced from the Governing Body of Esamoti Degree College, Dinajpur. 

 6. Mr. Mahbubey Alam, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners in C.P. No. 803 of 2011, submits that no Rule was issued in respect of the vires of Rule 6 of the জাতীয় বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় (অধিভুক্ত কলেজ/শিক্ষা প্রতিষ্ঠান সমূহরে গভর্নিং বডি)সংশোধন সংবিধি ১৯৯৮  and hence, the judgment of the High Court Division is palpably illegal He points out that in a similar case in Writ Petition No. 2124 of 2010 the High Court Division discharged the Rule by judgment and order dated 10.06.2010 and also the point arose in Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No.774 of 2004 where the Appellate Division did not interfere with the order passed in accordance with Rule 6 of the জাতীয় বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় (অধিভুক্ত কলেজ/শিক্ষা প্রতিষ্ঠান সমূহরে গভর্নিং বডি)সংশোধন সংবিধি ১৯৯৮ . He further submits that the aforementioned Rule 6 does not infringe the principle of natural justice in that the President of the Governing Body of the College is nominated by the authority of the National University and according to section 16 of the General Clauses Act the nominating authority has power to withdraw the nomination. 

 I. Whether the High Court Division illegally declared Rule 6 of জাতীয় বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় (অধিভুক্ত কলেজ/শিক্ষা প্রতিষ্ঠান সমূহরে গভর্নিং বডি)সংশোধন সংবিধি ১৯৯৮  to be ultra-vires since no Rule was issued to examine the wires of the said Rule 6. 

 II. Whether the Rule 6 of the জাতীয় বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় (অধিভুক্ত কলেজ/শিক্ষা প্রতিষ্ঠান সমূহরে গভর্নিং বডি)সংশোধন সংবিধি ১৯৯৮  infringes the principle of natural justice by giving the National University which nominates the President of the Governing Body, unfettered power to withdraw the 1 Appellate Division Cases said nomination at any time. 

 12. Let the operation of the judgment and order dated 25.04.2010 passed by the High Court Division so far as it relates to Rule 6 of the জাতীয় বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় (অধিভুক্ত কলেজ/শিক্ষা প্রতিষ্ঠান সমূহরে গভর্নিং বডি)সংশোধন সংবিধি ১৯৯৮  be stayed till disposal of the appeal in C.p. No. 803 of 2011.
